lines.zh: 我拖着长嘴，从水边爬上来。
lines.en: Dragging my long snout, I crawl up from the water.
My scales rasp the reeds.

lines.zh: 我一步一步，尾巴扫过去。
lines.en: Step by step, my tail sweeps behind me.

lines.zh: 湿泥上留下我的脚印和尾痕。
lines.en: Wet mud keeps my prints and my tail's track.

lines.zh: 我贴着水线走，找好东西。
lines.en: I walk the waterline looking for something good.

lines.zh: 我拖着长嘴，压过一片芦苇。
lines.en: Dragging my long snout, I press through the reeds.

lines.zh: 我笨重地挪过一片浅滩。
lines.en: I lumber across a shallow flat.
I go round the rocks so I don't wedge.

lines.zh: 我从荷叶间穿过去，压坏两片。
lines.en: I pass between lily pads and crush two.
Mud makes me heavier with each step.

lines.zh: 我停下抖了抖，水甩了一地。
lines.en: I stop and shake; water goes everywhere.

lines.zh: 我慢慢朝有动静的地方去。
lines.en: I head slowly toward the noise.
I lie at the bank with only my eyes showing.
Bugs on the water. I watch them.
I open my jaws slowly and stop.
My tail sways gently in the water.

lines.zh: 晒着太阳，我一点都不想动。
lines.en: In the sun I don't want to move at all.

lines.zh: 我背上的鳞片一块块排着。
lines.en: The scales on my back lie in rows.

lines.zh: 一只鸟落在我背上，我不理。
lines.en: A bird lands on my back. I ignore it.
Water drips from my jaw.
I'm waiting. I can afford to.
I blink slowly.

lines.zh: 泥里的气泡一个接一个。
lines.en: Bubbles rise from the mud, one after another.

lines.zh: 我打了个哈欠，牙齿一排。
lines.en: I yawn and a row of teeth shows.

lines.zh: 水草缠在我腿上，我甩开。
lines.en: Weed's tangled on my leg; I shake it off.

lines.zh: 我趴着，看起来像块木头。
lines.en: Lying here, I look like a log.

lines.zh: 我把下巴在石头上蹭了蹭。
lines.en: I rub my jaw on a stone.
I lie still and mud slowly covers my legs.

lines.zh: 你脚下的水，只到我的膝。
lines.en: The water at your feet barely reaches my knee.
I turn my head slowly.

lines.zh: 你的影子落在水面上了。
lines.en: Your shadow has fallen on the water.
I'm in no hurry. Walk on.
See this snout? Long, isn't it.
I open my mouth only to breathe.

lines.zh: 你要是扔东西过来，我会接。
lines.en: Throw something over and I'll catch it.

lines.zh: 你退了两步，踩进泥里了。
lines.en: You stepped back into the mud.

lines.zh: 这水塘归我，你只是路过。
lines.en: This pool is mine. You're passing through.

lines.zh: 我用十六个睡莲换来的这具身体。
lines.en: Sixteen lilies bought this body.
Want to fish out what's in my jaws?

lines.zh: 我慢慢爬过去，地都颤了。
lines.en: I crawl closer and the ground trembles.

lines.zh: 别站着不动，那太没意思。
lines.en: Don't just stand there. It's dull.

lines.zh: 你手上带铁味，像换我的料。
lines.en: Your hands smell of iron, like my price in ingots.
A mark on my scales.

lines.zh: 我把长嘴收回水线以下。
lines.en: I draw my long snout below the waterline.
That moved me back half a metre.
Mud's in the wound. It swells.

lines.zh: 我甩了甩头，血甩了一地。
lines.en: I shake my head and blood flies.
A blow under the scales; I keep it quiet.
I lie back down slowly to recover.
That thing of yours is heavy.
I gape my long jaws only to breathe.
I'll remember you for that.
That thing in your hand — throw it.
I smell it. Good.
I wait with my mouth open. Patiently.
Throw it high. I can catch it.

lines.zh: 水里的东西我都吃得下。
lines.en: I can eat anything from the water.

lines.zh: 我从泥里抬头，鼻子动了动。
lines.en: I lift my head from the mud and sniff.
A little closer. My jaws can't reach.
That smell set my tail moving.
I haul half my body forward.
Right. I'll wait.

lines.zh: 你撞在我的鳞甲上，很硬。
lines.en: You ran into my scales. Hard, aren't they.
I didn't move at all; you did.
My jaw hits the mud with a thud.

lines.zh: 退远些，我的尾巴扫过来。
lines.en: Stand clear; my tail is sweeping round.
I heave aside to let you pass.

lines.zh: 你在泥里滑了一下，撞到我。
lines.en: You slipped in the mud and hit me.
That weight means nothing to me.
My snout nearly touched you.
Back off. Don't stand in front of my jaws.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖，水溅了你一身。
lines.en: I shake and splash you all over.

lines.zh: 我一年到头就趴在这水塘。
lines.en: I lie in this pool all year.
First, let's see if you swim well.
There's only me in this mud.
A slow creature like me can't be hurried.

lines.zh: 你要留下，就别踩我的尾巴。
lines.en: If you stay, don't tread on my tail.
The water's better than the bank.

lines.zh: 我趴在旁边，你也在旁边。
lines.en: I lie here, and you lie here too.

lines.zh: 等你学会不动，我们再谈。
lines.en: Once you learn to be still, we'll talk.

lines.zh: 我的嘴不好看，你别介意。
lines.en: My jaws aren't pretty. Don't mind them.
The sun's down, and the water's cooling.

lines.zh: 水里浮上来一条鱼，我张嘴。
lines.en: A fish floats up; I open my jaws.
I clamp it and drag it ashore.
This shell is too hard to bite.
I press it into the mud.
Whatever falls in the water, I can fish out.
Half of one is still in my mouth.
One dip and the water flies.
This thing shines underwater.
I toss it ashore to eat at leisure.
This one lasts me all day.

lines.zh: 睡莲一动，我就知道是你。
lines.en: One stir of the lilies, and I know it's you.
Your steps shake the mud.
I open my eyes and line up slowly.
You're in the shallows. You can't retreat fast.

lines.zh: 我张开嘴，等你自己过来。
lines.en: I open my jaws and wait for you to come.
Mud all around this pool.
I hear you splashing.

lines.zh: 十六个睡莲，才换得到我。
lines.en: Sixteen lily pads just to get me.
My barrel's turning. Hold still.
You're heading for the bank. It's slippery.
I lay my tail across the shallows.
Good. No rush.

lines.zh: 我抬头的时候就是信号。
lines.en: When I lift my head, that's the signal.

lines.zh: 这一片水，都是我的猎场。
lines.en: All this water is my hunting ground.
I crawl along the mud bed.
Only my eyes break the surface.

lines.zh: 你的脚印在水边很清楚。
lines.en: Your prints are clear at the water's edge.
I work round to your flank, slowly.
Every step back sinks you in mud.
I count your splashes.

lines.zh: 水草挡住你一半的视线。
lines.en: The reeds block half your view.

lines.zh: 我把尾巴收起来，好发力。
lines.en: I gather my tail in to spring.
The longer you stand, the closer I get.
One more and I'm at your feet.
The water shows only the faintest ripple.
Right. Enough.

lines.zh: 我把身子压低，几乎贴着水。
lines.en: I flatten down almost flush with the water.

lines.zh: 我在泥里只露出一点背。
lines.en: Only a bit of my back shows above the mud.
You look back just as I sink.

lines.zh: 我一甩头，长嘴横扫过去。
lines.en: One swing of my head sweeps the snout across.
I want the boot and the water both.

lines.zh: 我甩尾，泥水一起抽过去。
lines.en: I whip my tail, mud and water with it.
I lunge and mud sprays everywhere.

lines.zh: 牙闭合的时候声音很响。
lines.en: My teeth come together loudly.

lines.zh: 我滚了半圈，压在你脚上。
lines.en: I roll half over and pin your foot.
My jaws are stronger than they look.
I hold you down, sinking into the soft mud.
In the water I'm nimbler.
That bite will stay with you a while.

lines.zh: 我从水下浮上来，泥水一起翻。
lines.en: I surface and mud churns with me.
Shallow pool. Just right.

lines.zh: 我爬上泥岸，鳞上全是水。
lines.en: I haul onto the mud bank, scales streaming.

lines.zh: 我把长嘴搁在一块石头上。
lines.en: I rest my long snout on a stone.

lines.zh: 芦苇被我压出一片空地。
lines.en: I've flattened a patch of reeds.

lines.zh: 我在水里转了个身，慢慢来。
lines.en: I turn in the water, slowly.

lines.zh: 池塘的鱼今天要小心了。
lines.en: The fish here should be careful today.
One move from me and the water clouds.
I grind my teeth on the mud bank.
A noise on the bank. I lift my head.
Soft mud. Good for lying on.
I'm here. This pool is mine.
I sink my tail under the water.
The sun's on me. I wait.

lines.zh: 火烤着我的鳞，一片片发白。
lines.en: Fire bleaches my scales one by one.

lines.zh: 我从岸上滑下去，摔在泥里。
lines.en: I slide off the bank into the mud.

lines.zh: 这不该淹到我，可水太浑了。
lines.en: This shouldn't drown me, but the water's thick.

lines.zh: 爆炸把泥掀起来，盖了我一身。
lines.en: The blast throws up mud that covers me.
An arrow sticks in my back scales.

lines.zh: 那力量让我的嘴合不上。
lines.en: That force won't let my jaws close.

lines.zh: 塘里没鱼了，我饿得发懒。
lines.en: No fish left. Hunger makes me sluggish.

lines.zh: 雷打在水面，我全身一抽。
lines.en: Lightning hits the water and I convulse.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有泥，我无处可趴。
lines.en: No mud in the void. Nowhere to lie.
